300.$description: Primary brand color. Header text, primary buttons, text-links.

900.$description: DEPRECATED — use Cashalo.Blue.300. Temporary alias for v1 → v2 migration.

300.$description: Highlighting active states, selected radios, checked boxes.

primary.$description: Primary brand color (blue). Use for primary CTAs, brand surfaces, and key interactive elements.

secondary.$description: Secondary brand color (gold). Use for active states, selected radios, accents.

muted.$description: Muted black text. Used for de-emphasized content.

modal-secondary.$description: Secondary button inside modals. Placeholder — consider adding a Modal Secondary primitive (#e7e7e7) to Misc.

outline-focus.$description: Outline color when input is focused.

outline-neutral.$description: Default outline color when input is idle.

radio-selected.$description: Selected radio fill. References the primary button fill so radio state matches CTA color.

bottomNavShadow.$description: For bottom navs to create a sense of containment and visual hierarchy.

cardShadow.$description: Use this on cards to create a sense of elevation and separation from the background surface

tight.$description: Hairline. Within a single element (e.g. icon next to text).

close.$description: Strongly related elements (e.g. label and its input).

related.$description: Items belonging to the same group.

grouped.$description: Default. Distinct items within a section.

loose.$description: Elements that share context but want breathing room.

separated.$description: Between groups in the same section.
